text:
Noah: FYI AuroraMesh flagged INV-2025-558 for $12,950 as disputed. They say usage spike was a meter miscount in Feb and want a credit memo. Payment is overdue 45 days.

Priya: Do we have DAO/usage logs to validate? If it's a metering glitch we should correct, but need evidence before issuing credit.

Hannah: Pulled logs: usage aligns with calls from their IPs, but I see an abnormal retry loop from 2025-02-18 03:00-03:20 UTC. Could be a client bug causing duplicates.

Raj: Collections note: they put a hold on the card after chargeback threat. They offered to pay 50% now and escrow the rest until dispute is resolved.

Noah: They proposed 50/50 + a mutual investigation period. Wanted to avoid suspension of service.

Ellen (Legal): We can accept an interim partial payment but need a signed dispute acknowledgment and holdback agreement. Also retain right to retroactively reclaim credit if logs show correct billing.

collections-bot: Invoice INV-2025-558 | Status: Overdue (45d) | Balance: $12,950 | Last action: customer dispute opened | Recommended: require signed dispute form + partial remittance to avoid suspension.

Priya: From ops: if we accept 50% now, we should mark invoice as part-paid and not auto-suspend for 14 days. After that, if dispute unresolved, re-evaluate.

Hannah: Ops can tag the usage window and run a dedupe job. I'll surface a short report in #eng-ml by EOD.

Noah: Marco (CFO) asked me to weigh in on revenue recognition impact — would a provisional credit affect MRR?

CFO - Marco: We shouldn't retroactively derecognize until investigation completes. A temporary AR hold is fine but log a contingent liability for the disputed amount.

Ellen (Legal): I'll draft a two-paragraph holdback agreement. Suggested clause: "Client will remit 50% of the disputed balance to avoid service suspension. The parties agree to investigate the billing period, and any final adjustments will be reflected in a credit memo or supplemental invoice." Approve?

Raj: Approve from collections. Also request to lock their provisioning change flags until resolved.

Priya: Approve from finance with condition: remittance must clear in 3 business days or we proceed with normal dunning.

Noah: I'll send the agreement, request wire/ACH proof and mark ticket #BILL-4909. Reminder: do not paste bank account numbers in channel, use secure-send.

collections-bot: Action items: 1) Noah send holdback agreement to client 2) Hannah run dedupe analysis 3) Priya & Marco log contingent liability 4) Raj pause suspensions for 14 days 5) Ellen prepare final T&Cs.

Priya: If client refuses partial remittance, escalate to late-fee + suspend per policy.

Noah: Copy. I'll update the billing ticket and ping sales for relationship impact.

Hannah: Will post analysis link to ticket when ready.

Ellen (Legal): I'll also add a clause to preserve our right to recover funds and fees if the dispute is found invalid.

Priya: Thanks. Closing loop here once we have signed agreement + payment proof.
